facts.claim: Mature SaaS contribution margins run 70% to 80%, with median software gross margin at 80% and 76% blended with services
facts.excerpt: For mature SaaS, contribution margins fall between 70-80%, while median software gross margin is 80%, and blended it is 76%.

facts.claim: Median gross margin for private SaaS between 5 million and 50 million dollars ARR is 71% to 74%
facts.excerpt: The median gross margin for private SaaS companies with $5M-$50M ARR is 71-74% in 2026.

facts.claim: Apple and Google both charge 15% on the first 1 million dollars of annual revenue and 30% above it, plus a 99 dollar and 25 dollar developer fee
facts.source_title: The 15% App Store Fee: A Guide for Developers
facts.excerpt: Apple App Store costs $99/year plus 15% for revenue under $1M/year, 30% above. Google Play charges $25 once plus 15% on first $1M/year, 30% above.

facts.claim: Razorpay charges Indian businesses 2% plus 18% GST on domestic payments and 3% on international card exports
facts.source_title: Payment gateway pricing for SaaS businesses in India
facts.excerpt: Razorpay charges 2% platform fee plus 18% GST for domestic payments, and 3% for international exports by card.

facts.claim: Marketplace take rates span under 2% to over 70%, and most established multi-vendor marketplaces sit between 10% and 20%
facts.excerpt: Marketplace take rates in 2026 range from under 2% to over 70%. Most established multi-vendor marketplaces charge between 10 and 20%.

facts.claim: Indian D2C brands lose 30% to 35% of revenue to quick-commerce platforms across listing fees, mandatory ad spend, commission and operations
facts.excerpt: For D2C brands, platforms consume 30% to 35% of revenue between listing fees, mandatory ad spend, commission, and operations.
